Find Transformers palettes that suit a plotting use case

Source: R/usecase.R
tf_find_palettes.Rd

Filters the palettes to those whose colors work for a given job, judged from the perceptual statistics in tf_palette_stats(). Many toys look great on a figure but poor on a chart; this surfaces the ones that hold up.

Usage

tf_find_palettes(
  use = c("categorical", "colorblind", "sequential", "diverging"),
  faction = NULL,
  team = NULL,
  role = NULL,
  medium = "toy",
  min_colours = 4
)

Arguments

use

One of:

"categorical"

Every pair of colors is clearly distinguishable (minimum Lab distance of 20 or more). Good for unordered groups.

"colorblind"

Categorical, and still distinguishable under simulated deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia (minimum distance 15 or more in each).

"sequential"

One hue family (hue spread of 45 degrees or less among the chromatic colors) spanning at least 50 units of lightness, so a continuous gradient reads as low-to-high. Pair with sort = TRUE in tf_palette() or the _c scales.

"diverging"

Exactly two distinct hue families plus a light or neutral color to sit between them. The curated order is not necessarily dark-A, light, dark-B; check tf_palette_stats() and reorder the colors yourself for a continuous diverging scale.

The thresholds are deliberately simple heuristics computed by tf_palette_stats(); treat the result as a shortlist to look at with tf_show_palettes(), not a guarantee.

faction, team, role, medium

Optional filters passed to tf_palette_names(). medium defaults to "toy"; use "all" to search cartoon and comic palettes too.

min_colours

Minimum number of colors the palette must have.

Value

A character vector of palette names, ordered so that the strongest candidates for the use case come first.

Examples

tf_find_palettes("colorblind")
#>  [1] "blades"        "computron"     "air_raid"      "huffer"       
#>  [5] "superion"      "brawn"         "scattershot"   "jallguar"     
#>  [9] "fireflight"    "hot_spot"      "defensor"      "trailbreaker" 
#> [13] "silverbolt"    "nosecone"      "ratchet"       "sunstreaker"  
#> [17] "bumblebee"     "cliffjumper"   "windcharger"   "gears"

#> [41] "bombshell"     "kickback"      "first_aid"     "streetwise"   
#> [45] "skydive"       "galvatron"     "optimus_prime" "wreck_gar"
